fireTea.name: Fire Tea
fireTea.description: A dark, sweet drink crafted from redberry vine, moonpetal, and blackroot. Potent but safe. Rapidly increases desire, sensitivity, and stamina. One cup is sufficient. No dangerous side effects when properly dosed.
fireTea.purpose: To make adult women brought for breeding more receptive and better able to handle the process.
fireTea.storage: Sealed jars on the shelves in the upper plateau residence
